confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for peak July 2026 in Positano, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence. Accommodation anchors are lower confidence because Positano has few registered hostels and room rates are highly seasonal and volatile, so hostel_dorm_1p and hostel_private_2p are the least certain. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries that cite rba.gov.au for 2026-10-15. I did not open the RBA page directly, so the value should be confirmed against the official F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Positano is priced at the top of the Amalfi Coast tier, with a peak-season premium above nearby towns such as Amalfi, Sorrento and Capri. Restaurant and bar anchors are based on that Amalfi Coast peak-season price level. Accommodation anchors reflect the scarcity of registered budget options in Positano itself, so the hostel and budget hotel figures are bounded estimates.
